name: Tommy Jackett
entityStatement: Tommy Jackett is a Melbourne filmmaker and storyteller. He co-hosts and co-wrote the documentary In Guns We Trust (2026), and runs VIDPOD, a video production company.

film.title: In Guns We Trust

whenShort.before: Free on YouTube. Friday 23 October, 11am AEDT (Thursday 22 October, 8pm ET).
whenShort.after: It's out now. Watch it free on YouTube.

whenFull.after: It's out now. Watch it free on YouTube, worldwide.

film.contentNote: Includes gunfire and discussion of shootings, suicide and loss. Made for adults and older teenagers watching with support.
film.support: Support: in the US call or text 988. In Australia call Lifeline on 13 11 14. Elsewhere, findahelpline.com.
film.supportInline: If you need someone to talk to: US 988, Australia Lifeline 13 11 14, findahelpline.com.
film.timeNote: ET is US Eastern. AEDT is Melbourne time.
film.creditLine: In Guns We Trust is made by 2A Film, Full Stack Films and Rethink Films. Film images are stills from In Guns We Trust (2026), directed by Josh Janssen. © 2026 2A Film Pty Ltd.
film.oneLiner: A 2026 feature documentary: two unarmed Australians listen to gun owners, survivors and sheriffs across America.
film.synopsis: In a nation where the right to bear arms is sacred, two unarmed Australian mates, Josh and Tommy, travel across America to uncover the stories, contradictions, and convictions behind its love affair with guns, finding that empathy, not arguments, may be the only way to bridge the divide.
film.rule: Two Australian mates cross America with cameras and one rule: no side, no agenda, just conversations.
film.contentNoteShort: Includes gunfire and discussion of shootings, suicide and loss.

lead.after: Here it is. Our feature documentary is out now.
